restriction.title: Restrict Data Processing
restriction.description: Under GDPR/NDPR you may request that we restrict processing of your personal data in certain circumstances. Enabling this flag signals that restriction to our systems.
restriction.toggleLabel: Restrict processing of my personal data (your account will remain accessible but certain automated processing will be paused pending review).

export.title: Download My Data
export.description: Export a copy of your personal data in JSON format (right of portability under GDPR/NDPR).

delete.title: Delete Account
delete.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action is irreversible. All your data — cases, documents, billing history — will be erased and cannot be recovered.
delete.dialogTitle: Delete Account — This Cannot Be Undone
delete.dialogWarning: You are about to permanently delete your account and all data associated with it. Once deleted, your cases, documents, team, and billing history cannot be recovered.
delete.dialogInstructions: Type DELETE and enter your password to confirm.

google.description: Enable OAuth-based sign-in for users managed in Google Workspace
google.enableHelp: Users will be redirected to Google for authentication when this is enabled.
google.clientIdTooltip: In Google Cloud Console, create an OAuth client under APIs & Services → Credentials. Use the Web application type.
google.redirectUriTooltip: Copy the callback URL provided by Kourti AI into the Authorized redirect URIs list in Google Cloud.
google.clientSecretTooltip: Download the credentials JSON from Google Cloud and paste the client secret here.
google.domainHintTooltip: Restrict access to members of a specific Google Workspace domain (e.g. example.com). Optional but recommended.
google.domainHintHelp: Optional. Restrict sign-in to a single Google Workspace domain.
google.saveFirst: Please save your Google Workspace configuration first.

microsoft.enableHelp: Redirect users to the Microsoft login page for authentication.
microsoft.clientIdTooltip: In Azure Portal, under App registrations, create a new registration and copy the Application ID.
microsoft.tenantIdTooltip: Find the Directory ID in Azure Portal under Azure Active Directory → Overview.
microsoft.redirectUriTooltip: Add this redirect URI to the list of allowed URIs in your Azure app's Authentication settings.
microsoft.clientSecretTooltip: Generate a new client secret in Azure Portal under Certificates & secrets, then paste it here.
microsoft.domainHintTooltip: Provide a preferred domain hint for the Microsoft sign-in page (e.g. contoso.com). Optional.
microsoft.domainHintHelp: Optional. Pre-fill the Microsoft login page with this domain.

matterTypes.intro: The types and issues offered in New Matter. Removing an item hides it from new matters; existing matters keep it, and it can be restored. Default items can be removed but not renamed - add your own instead.
matterTypes.newTypePlaceholder: New matter type, e.g. Construction disputes
matterTypes.empty: No matter types. Add one or import a CSV - without types, new matters cannot be created.
matterTypes.noIssues: No issues - matters of this type are created without one.

removal.hidden: "{{name}}" removed for your firm (default items can be restored).
removal.retired_one: "{{name}}" retired: no longer offered for new matters; {{count}} existing matter keeps it.
removal.retired_other: "{{name}}" retired: no longer offered for new matters; {{count}} existing matters keep it.

removeDefaults.description: They (and their issues) will no longer be offered for new matters. Existing matters keep their type. You can restore any of them later with "Show removed". Add or import your own types before your team creates new matters.

import.title: Import matter types from {{file}}
import.modeMerge: Add to the current list - nothing is removed; existing names are reused.
import.modeReplace: Replace the current list - every type and issue not in the file is removed (defaults hidden, unused custom ones deleted, ones used by matters retired).
import.expectedColumns: Expected columns: matter_type, matter_issue (optional descriptions after).

contractTypes.intro: The types offered when creating, uploading or editing a contract. Removing a type hides it from new contracts; existing contracts keep it, and it can be restored. Default types can be removed but not renamed - add your own instead. Renaming your own type also renames it on existing contracts.
contractTypes.newTypePlaceholder: New contract type, e.g. Construction contract
contractTypes.empty: No contract types. Add one or import a CSV.

removal.hidden: "{{name}}" removed for your firm (default types can be restored).
removal.retired_one: "{{name}}" retired: no longer offered for new contracts; {{count}} existing contract keeps it.
removal.retired_other: "{{name}}" retired: no longer offered for new contracts; {{count}} existing contracts keep it.

removeDefaults.description: They will no longer be offered for new contracts. Existing contracts keep their type. You can restore any of them later with "Show removed".

import.title: Import contract types from {{file}}
import.modeMerge: Add to the current list - nothing is removed; existing names are reused.
import.modeReplace: Replace the current list - every type not in the file is removed (defaults hidden, unused custom ones deleted, ones used by contracts retired).

taskTypes.intro: Each task type can have a default reminder: new tasks of that type start with it, and the person creating the task can switch it off or change it. Reminders go to the task's assignee on the day (from 08:00), by the channels you tick.
taskTypes.adminOnly: Only firm administrators can change the defaults.
